newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech fund Zivno AGM approves CZK 20 div.
newsitem.headline: Czech fund Zivno AGM approves CZK 20 div.

text.p: Shareholders of Czech investment fund Zivnobanka - 1.IF voted at Friday's annual general meeting to pay out a 20 crown gross dividend per share on 1996 earnings, after a 15 crown dividend the previous year, a spokesman said.
The investment fund showed a net profit of 83.3 million crowns last year after 71.3 million crowns in 1995.
The fund is managed by ZB Trust, an investment arm of bank Zivnostenska Banka a.s..
Zivnostenska Banka holds a 15 percent stake in the fund, whose shares are traded on the main market of the Prague Stock Exchange.
